courses.title: Front-End Implementation for Designers
courses.description: Front-End Implementation for Designers focuses on front-end implementation for people working toward a Product Designer role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces prototyping, enough to apply alongside front-end implementation in real Product Designer work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to front-end implementation and show how prototyping supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying front-end implementation to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing front-end implementation through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to prototyping
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Accessibility
courses.description: Applying Accessibility is a focused course on accessibility for people already working toward a Product Designer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying accessibility on your own.

courses.description: Getting Started with Animation for Interfaces is a short introduction to animation for interfaces for people moving toward a Product Designer role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show animation for interfaces in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if animation for interfaces is new to you.

courses.title: A Short Guide to Performance Optimization
courses.description: A Short Guide to Performance Optimization walks you through the basics of performance optimization, built for people new to Product Designer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of performance optimization, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying performance optimization to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing performance optimization through guided exercises
Building a short performance optimization exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
